text: Someone has whitewashed the low wall by the gate, and someone else has already put a handprint in it. A woman selling figs says the feast is for the god of the storm, or perhaps for the king’s safe return; she is not certain, and the figs are dear either way.

sources: Ugaritic ritual calendars and festival texts, general
provenance.notes: Whitewashing, handprints and a storm-god feast are plausible; the speaker and the uncertainty are invented.
